headline: Carbon Health faces regulatory settlement over corporate practice of medicine; compliance posture now under scrutiny

signals.category: Regulatory settlement - Corporate Practice of Medicine
signals.summary: Carbon Health reached a landmark settlement with California AG over corporate practice of medicine (CPOM) violations involving PC-MSO structures and clinic contracts. The settlement includes contract revisions and penalties, triggering broader state scrutiny of friendly-PC arrangements in healthcare.
signals.suggestedAction: Schedule a compliance posture review with Carbon Health's legal/compliance team. Position Email Archiving as a critical tool for regulatory defense: offer to discuss retention policies for physician employment contracts, billing records, and corporate governance communications to ensure audit-ready records.
